title: Centrus Announces Pricing of $500 Million Underwritten Public Offering of Class A Common Stock and Warrants
summary: Centrus Energy Corp. (NYSE: LEU) ("Centrus" or the "Company") today announced the pricing of its previously announced underwritten public offering of 500,000 shares of its Class A common stock (the "Class A Common Stock"), pre-funded warrants (the "Pre-Funded Warrants") to purchase an aggregate of 2,005,513 shares of Class A Common Stock and common warrants (the "Common Warrants") to purchase up to an aggregate of 6,992,382 shares of Class A Common Stock.
